items.title: Vedanta, Vedanta Aluminium post strong Q1 gains as metal prices lift earnings
items.description: After their demerger, Vedanta and Vedanta Aluminium Metal have reported robust financial outcomes for the first quarter, primarily due to rising commodity prices. Both companies are eyeing substantial capital investments to propel their growth strategies. With aluminium and base metal prices expected to stay strong in the near future, they are currently valued lower than their industry rivals, indicating potential for upward movement.
